== Problem == Mindy made three purchases for \textdollar 1.98 dollars, \textdollar 5.04 dollars, and \textdollar 9.89 dollars. What was her total, to the nearest dollar? \textbf{(A)}\ 10\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 15\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 16\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 17\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 18 == Solution == The three prices round to \textdollar 2 , \textdollar 5 , and \textdollar 10 , which have a sum of \boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 17} . We know that there will not be a rounding error, as the total amount rounded is clearly less than \textdollar 0.50 . ==Video Solution by WhyMath== https://youtu.be/ZVg9Rva8ZIg ==See Also== {{AMC8 box|year=2006|before=First
